name: AR_INTEREST_HEADERS_ALL
description: The AR_INTEREST_HEADERS_ALL table contains header level late charge document information.

columns.name: INTEREST_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Interest header identifier. It is used as a primary key.

columns.name: INTEREST_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ra_interest_batches_all.interest_batch_id

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS_ALL.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL.SITE_USE_ID.

columns.name: HEADER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of late charges documents ADJ, DM, INV

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code from FND_CURRENCIES.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_CALCULATION_TRX
columns.description: Eligibility criteria to select transactions for late charge processing based on overdue invoices and late payments.

columns.name: CREDIT_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Eligibility criteria to select transactions for late charge processing based on optional late charges

columns.name: DISPUTED_TRANSACTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Eligibility criteria to select transactions for late charge processing based on optional late charges

columns.name: PAYMENT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Grace days after which payment is considered late and eligible for late charge calculation.

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TERM_ID
columns.description: If late charge type is DEBIT_MEMO/INTEREST_INVOICE then the payment term must be populated,this is used to create the Invoice or Debit Memo

columns.name: INTEREST_PERIOD_DAYS
columns.description: Days in interest period

columns.name: INTEREST_CALCULATION_PERIOD
columns.description: Period over which to calculate late charges for the customer.

columns.name: CHARGE_ON_FINANCE_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Formula on overdue amount to compute interest.

columns.name: HOLD_CHARGED_INVOICES_FLAG
columns.description: Place a hold on charged invoices

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Message text printed on the late charge transaction. Applies only to late charges recorded as invoices or debit memos. Foreign key to AR_STANDARD_TEXT.STANDARD_TEXT_ID.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_INTEREST_RATES_FLAG
columns.description: Use Multiple Interest Rates

columns.name: CHARGE_BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: Start date for last charge calculation.

columns.name: CUST_ACCT_PROFILE_AMT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to HZ_CUST_PROFILE_AMTS.CUST_ACCT_PROFILE_AMT_ID

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum Invoice amount overdue type

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold amount below which late charges must not be charged.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold percentage below which late charges must not be charged.

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum customer balance overdue type

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Customer balance threshold amount below which the late charge must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Customer balance percentage threshold below which the late charge must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount below  which the late charge must not charged.

columns.name: MAX_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount above which the late charge must not be charged.

columns.name: INTEREST_TYPE
columns.description: Fixed amount, percent, charges schedule based interest.

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest rate

columns.name: INTEREST_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest amount

columns.name: INTEREST_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to AR_CHARGES_SCHEDULES.SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: PENALTY_TYPE
columns.description: Fixed amount, percent, charges schedule based penalty.

columns.name: PENALTY_RATE
columns.description: Penalty rate

columns.name: PENALTY_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Penalty amount

columns.name: PENALTY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to AR_CHARGES_SCHEDULES.SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: LAST_ACCRUE_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: Date as of which last compounded

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES.CUST_ACCOUNT_PROFILE_ID.

columns.name: COLLECTOR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to collectors entity

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of the legal entity

columns.name: PROCESS_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message text

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Status code to indicate Success or Error

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WORKER_NUM
columns.description: Worker Id which created the header for the request id

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FINANCE_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: Date as of which the finance charge was generated

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Transaction type sequence identifier.
